summary: Iteration 74 backend-only verification — 12/12 pytest tests PASSED against https://highlight-vibe-bugs.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified the iter74 backend additions: (1) TrainerProfileCreate Pydantic model now accepts legacy `profilePhoto` field and the route handler at /app/backend/routes/profile_routes.py L46-52 correctly syncs it BOTH to profile.avatarUrl AND to users.profilePhoto (proven by clearing avatarUrl on the profile and confirming the GET handler's fallback at L77 re-surfaces the value from users.profilePhoto). (2) Canonical `avatarUrl` field still works on POST + GET. (3) POST /api/trainer-profiles/{uid}/highlights/base64 uploads a base64 PNG, returns {success:true, highlight:{url:/api/files/..., type:'photo', caption}}, GET /api/trainer-profiles/{uid}/highlights includes it, and GET /api/files/{path} serves the raw image bytes with image/* content-type. (4) Admin verification detail returns 7 steps each with a `url` field (photo step's url is populated after the avatarUrl sync); POST /api/admin/verifications/{uid}/approve-step with valid stepId returns 200 {success:true, message:str}; missing stepId returns 400 — sufficient shape for the FE to gate invalid Approved+No-file state. (5) Regression green: admin/trainee/trainer login, POST /api/sessions (iter73 booking flow), GET /api/trainee/sessions?session_status=requested, GET /api/trainer/verification-status with all 7 steps.

minor.issue: UserResponse Pydantic model (backend/models.py L187-194) does NOT expose `profilePhoto`. So once users.profilePhoto is synced, the FE can't read it back via /me — only via /api/trainer-profiles/{uid}. Not blocking iter74 (FE uses trainer-profiles endpoint), but is a latent inconsistency: trainee-side flows that rely on /me to render the avatar will silently lose the sync. Consider adding `profilePhoto: Optional[str] = None` to UserResponse.

action_items: Optional: add `profilePhoto: Optional[str] = None` to UserResponse model so /api/auth/me exposes the synced photo (minor; iter74 FE doesn't depend on it).
Main agent can self-test the 5 frontend punch-list items via Expo (web preview not reliable for RN). Backend contracts they depend on are all green.
critical_code_review_comments: P3 (carryover): /app/backend/routes/profile_routes.py is 1109 lines, mixing trainer profile, trainee profile, gallery, highlights, verification, and file-serving. Split into focused modules.
P3 (carryover from iter73): /app/backend/routes/session_routes.py >1550 lines, still needs splitting.

P2: TrainerProfileCreate.profilePhoto is described as legacy/alias for avatarUrl, but both fields coexist in the Pydantic model and the dict is dumped wholesale into Mongo. After sync, both profilePhoto AND avatarUrl are persisted on the trainer_profiles document — wastes space and risks drift if a future POST only sets avatarUrl (profilePhoto stays as stale legacy value). Consider deleting profile_doc['profilePhoto'] after sync.

P2: profile_routes.py L46-52 — when profilePhoto is supplied, `db.users.update_one` is called inside POST /trainer-profiles, but there is NO equivalent rollback if the trainer_profiles update_one fails afterwards. Wrap in a try/except or use a transaction.

P3: /api/admin/verifications/{trainer_id}/approve-step (admin_routes.py L736-788) blindly writes `{stepId}Approved=true` to trainer_profiles without validating that the document for that step was actually submitted (url present). The new FE-side disable handles UX, but a malicious/buggy client can still flip the flag. Recommend re-fetching the profile, asserting the corresponding `*Uploaded`/`*FileUri` field, and returning 400 if missing.
